name: Affinite Back in Stock
author: Affinite.io

sections.description:
Enhance your WooCommerce shop with automated out-of-stock notifications and instant restock alerts, ensuring customers always have access to their preferred products.

This optimal solution keeps your customers engaged and informed about product availability. Automatically alert subscribers once out-of-stock items are replenished. Boost sales with timely stock notifications, keep customers involved with up-to-the-minute updates. Monitor interest levels and transform subscribers into dedicated buyers.

Supported Product Types of WooCommerce

Simple
Variable
Grouped

Features:

  • Automatically notify subscribers when products are restocked.
  • Automatically confirm waiting list subscriptions.
  • Admin recive emais when there are enough waiting users.
  • Avoid duplicate email entries to enhance notification lists.
  • Compatible with WPML for multilingual support.
  • Supports both guest and member users smoothly.
  • Integrates seamlessly with product backorder options.
  • Allows for the configuration of a specific administrator email to receive alerts and notifications.
  • Customize the form’s heading, button text
  • More features coming soon

Upcoming Features:

  • DeferedScheduled Email Sending for Improved Website Performance
  • Customize the popup and button style, colors and more
  • Reposition stock alert button
  • Log of sent emails
  • MailChimp Integration

Upcoming Features:

If you find any errors in the plugin, or if you need help, please write to the Support thread or email info@affinite.io.
sections.installation:
1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Affinite Back In Stock
  3. Install plugin once it appears
  4. Activate plugin from your Plugins page.
  5. Go to “after activation” below.

Manually

  1. Upload the affinite-back-in-stock folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “after activation” below.

After activation

  1. Go into WooCommerce > Back in Stock Notification.
  2. Setup plugin option.
